Volume - 160 BENGALURU, FRIDAY, 16, MAY, 2025(VAISHAKHA, 26, SHAKAVARSHA, 1947) | Issue 93

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RC-CFS0ADMN/87/2023-RC Karnataka Government Secretariat
E- 1262413 Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru-560 001,
Date:05.05.2025.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/87/2023-RC,
E- 1262413 Dated: 05.02.2024 regarding altering the limits of Medleri village of
Ranebennur Taluk and Haveri District and constituting a new revenue village called
Durgapura was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette dated:12.02.2024
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Haveri district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:01.06.2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Medleri village of Ranebennur Taluk and Haveri District to form a new revenue
village called as Durgapura village of Ranebennur Taluk and Haveri District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/470/2024-RC, E- 1508895
Dated: 24.09.2024 regarding altering the limits of Airani village of Ranebennur Taluk
and Haveri District and constituting a new revenue village called Huvinamaradi was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka
act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette dated:21.11.2024 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the
date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner
Haveri district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:27.11.2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Airani village of Ranebennur Taluk and Haveri District to form a new revenue village
Huvinamaradi of Ranebennur Taluk and Haveri District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RC-CFS0ADMN/112/2024-RC,
Dated: 25-01-2024 regarding altering the limits of Janekunte village of Ballari Taluk
and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called Janekunte Thanda
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated: 26-02-2024 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty
days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 29-02-2024; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said

village Janekunte of Ballari Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue village
called as Janekunte Thanda of Ballari Taluk in Ballari District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RC-CFS0ADMN/491/2024-RC E-
1595316, Dated: 02.01.2025 regarding altering the limits of Koralli village of Aland
Taluk and Kalaburgi District and constituting a new revenue village called Koralli
Tanda(Narsing Nagar) was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette
dated:20.01.2025 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburgi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:05.02.2025 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Koralli village of Aland Taluk and Kalaburgi District to form a new revenue village
called as Koralli Tanda(Narsing Nagar) village of Aland Taluk and Kalaburgi
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

village was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated: 30.12.2023 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty
days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Kalaburagi district.

Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE

shall be declared as habitation area of called Ramteerth Tanda village of Chitthapur
taluk of Kalaburagi District convert the same to form hamlet/part within the boundary
of Ramteerth revenue village and same will here in after be named as Ramteerth
Tanda of Ramteerth village in Chitthapur Taluka of Kalaburgi District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RC-CFS0ADMN/62/2024-RC
Dated:17-01-2024 regarding altering the limits of Kotehalu village of Siruguppa
Taluk and Ballari District and constituting a new revenue village called Benchi Camp
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated: 02-02-2024 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty
days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Ballari district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:12-02-2024; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Kotehalu of Siruguppa Taluk and Ballari District to form a new revenue
village called as Benchi Camp of Siruguppa Taluk in Ballari District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of HORTI Village of INDI taluk VIJAYAPUR District
and to constitute a new revenue villages called SONIYA NAGAR, SINDHU
NAGAR, BHIMANAYAK NAGAR as specified in schedule along with maps with
old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, VIJAYAPUR
District.

HORTI Village of INDI taluk VIJAYAPUR District to form a new revenue village
called SONIYA NAGAR Village of INDI taluk VIJAYAPUR District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Bhuvanahalli Village of Krishnarajanagara Taluk,
Mysore District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Hosakoppalu as
specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned
to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Mysore District.

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Bhuvanahalli of Krishnarajanagara Taluk Mysore District to form a new
revenue village called as Hosakoppalu of Krishnarajanagara Taluk Mysore District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand under land
revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard to the
administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose s to issue a
Notification to alter the limits of Mulepetlu Village of K.R.Nagar Taluk of Mysore
District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Mulepetlu as specified in
schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of of
Mulepetlu village for conversion of Mulepetlu unrecorded habitation in to hamlet/part
of the said revenue village.
Now , therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said
Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be
affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after
thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Mysore
District.

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the table
shall be declared ashabitation area of Mulepetlu village of K.R.Nagar Taluk of Mysore
District convert the same to form hamlet within the boundary of Mulepetlu Revenue
village and same will herein after be named as called Mulepetlu of Mulepetlu village
in K.R.Nagar Taluk of Mysore District.

District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Linganawadi as specified
in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburagi
District.
